alice: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem. We left with 4 open actions: (1) cache eviction fix, (2) add regression evals, (3) ops runbook update, (4) incident-pattern mapping. Need owners and tickets.
ben: I'll take (1) and (2). Will open a Jira for the fix + add eval prompts.
carla: I'll own (3) ops runbook + rollout checklist. Happy to pair for the canary steps.
diane: For (4) pattern mapping, suggest Evan leads because he already correlated logs. Diane = backup.
ev an: happy to lead mapping. I have two log queries that show the KV growth and eviction spikes. I'll attach outputs.
pm-bot: Jira ticket created RW-3499 by @ben - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-3499
ben: RW-3499: Codefix + test + perf regression eval. Assignee: ben. ETA: PR by 2026-03-27, canary 2026-03-30.
carla: RW-3500 created for docs/runbook by @carla - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-3500
diane: Can we capture acceptance criteria on both tickets? Ex: 1) no kv_cache_size growth > 10% under synthetic workload X, 2) canary passes 48h.
ben: Agree. I'll add ACs to RW-3499. Also adding the eval prompt we used to detect regression: 
```
# eval prompt: long-prefix-repeat
generate 512 tokens using repeating tokens to stress KV cache
measure kv_cache_size every 10s
```
evan: Here are the two grep commands I used to gather historical incidents. Paste into ticket under "Diagnostics":
```
# top kv entries
zgrep "kv_cache_size" /var/log/*/service.log | sort -k3 -n | tail -n 100
# incidents grouped by cause
awk -F"|" '/eviction/ || /oom/ {print $1,$3,$5}' /var/log/incidents.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr
```
alice: Nice. Evan, please attach sample outputs (top 5 entries) and a short summary linking to the two earlier incidents (IDs 2026-03-11 and 2026-02-18) so we can confirm recurrence.
evan: done, added to RW-3499 -> Diagnostics. Linked RW-3460 and RW-3411.
carla: RACI proposal for RW-3499 & RW-3500: Ben = R, Carla = A (docs/rollout), Evan = C (diagnostics), Alice = I (pm), Diane = C (SRE review). I'll put a tiny table in both tickets.
ben: Handing over runbook tasks to @carla but I'll remain primary for the PR + perf tests.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for rw-dedicated-prod by @carla on 2026-03-30T02:00Z
diane: Any infra quotas or infra-safety approvals needed?
carla: No quotas expected; will run canary in isolated pool. Security checked and ok for the patch scope.
alice: Let's have a 15m sync Mon 2026-03-29 09:30 UTC to confirm PR state and canary readiness. If all green, close PM follow-up by 2026-04-06.
ben: ack :thumbsup:
carla: ack. I'll post the canary playbook in RW-3500 and ping infra before rollout.
pm-bot: Reminder created: PM follow-up RW-3499 sync - 2026-03-29 09:30 UTC
